typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	RunDate as timestamp (toTimestamp('9/11/2025 1:03:12 PM')),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		WorkflowId as string,
		WFName as string,
		WFProposalName as string,
		WFType as string,
		WFState as string,
		WFCreatedBy as string,
		WFCreatedDate as string,
		WFActivatedBy as string,
		WFActivatedDate as string,
		WFCompletedDate as string,
		WFCanceledBy as string,
		WFCanceledDate as string,
		{Proposal ID} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(Snapshot_Asof_Date = $RunDate,
		Snapshot_Active_Flag = 'Y') ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		WFCompletedDate as string,
		SNAPSHOT_AS_OF_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		WFCanceledDate as string,
		WFActivatedDate as string,
		WorkflowId as string,
		WFCanceledBy as string,
		WFName as string,
		WFCreatedDate as string,
		SNAPSHOT_ACTIVE_FLAG as string,
		WFProposalName as string,
		WFType as string,
		ProposalID as string,
		WFCreatedBy as string,
		WFState as string,
		WFActivatedBy as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		WFCompletedDate,
		SNAPSHOT_AS_OF_DATE = Snapshot_Asof_Date,
		WFCanceledDate,
		WFActivatedDate,
		WorkflowId,
		WFCanceledBy,
		WFName,
		WFCreatedDate,
		SNAPSHOT_ACTIVE_FLAG = Snapshot_Active_Flag,
		WFProposalName,
		WFType,
		ProposalID = {Proposal ID},
		WFCreatedBy,
		WFState,
		WFActivatedBy),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
